wins.text: North America Q2 revenue grew 9%, with wholesale up 24% and Running delivering high double-digit growth across all channels; NIKE.com posted its best Black Friday ever
Running grew over 20% for the second consecutive quarter, up double digits in every channel including NIKE Direct, with market share gains
Wholesale grew 8% globally; order book for spring and summer is growing in both seasons, with Football booking units nearly 40% higher than World Cup '22
North America gross margins declined only 330 bps despite 520 bps of tariff headwind, demonstrating underlying margin recovery from Win Now actions
Classics footwear franchises on track to decline more than $4 billion from peak levels by fiscal year-end, with inventory down 3% YoY and units down high single digits

risks.text: Greater China Q2 revenue declined 16%, EBIT declined 49% on a reported basis, with NIKE Digital down 36%; unplanned inventory obsolescence charges taken in the quarter
Tariffs represent $1.5B annualized incremental product costs, a gross headwind of ~320 bps to gross margin in FY26; net impact reduced to ~120 bps but still significant
Q3 revenue guided down low single digits; gross margins guided down 175-225 bps including 315 bps tariff impact, with Greater China and Converse expected to remain at Q2 trend levels
NIKE Direct declined 9% globally (Digital -14%, Stores -3%), reflecting intentional repositioning but still a meaningful top-line drag
APLA revenue down 4% with mixed country results; EMEA revenue down 1% with heavier-than-expected promotional activity and double-digit inventory growth

guidance_items.detail: Q3 revenues expected to be down low single digits, with modest growth in North America offset by continued declines in Greater China and Converse similar to Q2; includes ~3-point FX benefit
Q3 gross margins expected down ~175-225 bps; excluding 315 bps tariff impact, underlying gross margin would be positive expansion
Q3 SG&A dollars expected up low single digits due to higher demand creation and sport offense investments
Q3 other expense net of interest income expected to be income of $0-$10M

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Timeline to return to double-digit EBIT margins and whether management would provide 2-3 year targets
Whether North America's recovery playbook is directly applicable to China and the expected timeline for China's bottom
Mix breakdown of North America wholesale growth between liquidation/value channels vs. full-price sell-through and sustainability of that growth rate
